fact: On 23 October 2025 the first meeting of the national technical group launched ILLIMI Niger, a joint Government-UN platform integrating AI tools for predictive analysis, with six national institutions (HACP, MISPAT, DGPPD, CASEFSE, INS, ANSI) involved.
title: ILLIMI Niger : Les données au service de la sécurité humaine et de la paix
